common.back.description: Generic action that returns to the previous step.

common.cancel.description: Generic action that abandons the current operation.

common.close.description: Generic action or accessible name that dismisses a panel or dialog.

common.confirm.description: Generic action that accepts a confirmation prompt.

common.continue.description: Generic action that advances to the next step.

common.delete.description: Generic action that removes the selected item.

common.done.description: Generic action that finishes the current flow.

common.genericError.description: Generic failure sentence shown when no more specific error applies.

common.loading.description: Generic indicator shown while content is being fetched.

common.retry.description: Generic action that retries a failed operation.

common.save.description: Generic action that persists the current changes.

common.search.description: Generic label or accessible name for a search input.
